<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
:root{
  --bg:#03020a;--purple:#7B2DFF;--pink:#FF2D78;--cyan:#00EEFF;--gold:#FFD24C;
  --white:#fff;--muted:rgba(255,255,255,.55);--glass:rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  --border:rgba(123,45,255,.30);--borderf:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  --r:16px;--rp:100px;
  --FH:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;--FB:'Inter',sans-serif;--FS:'Instrument Serif',serif;
  --rainbow:linear-gradient(90deg,#FF3B3F,#FF8C42,#FFD93D,#6BCB77,#4D96FF,#7B68EE,#C56CF0);
}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--white);font-family:var(--FB);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
#sf{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
.pride{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px;background:var(--rainbow);z-index:300}

/* NAV */
nav{position:fixed;top:88px;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 36px;background:rgba(3,2,10,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
.nav-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--FH);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:22px;font-size:.73rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--white)}
.nav-gold{color:rgba(255,210,76,.75)!important}
.nav-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));color:var(--white);padding:9px 20px;border-radius:var(--rp);font-size:.73rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(123,45,255,.35);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;white-space:nowrap}
.nav-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 0 36px rgba(123,45,255,.6)}

/* HAMBURGER · mobile nav */
.nav-burger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px;background:none;border:none;z-index:10}
.nav-burger span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:2px;transition:transform .25s,opacity .25s}
.nav-burger.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.nav-burger.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.nav-burger.open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}
.nav-mobile-menu{display:none;position:fixed;top:130px;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(3,2,10,.98);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(123,45,255,.3);padding:18px 28px;flex-direction:column;gap:0;z-index:199}
.nav-mobile-menu.open{display:flex}
.nav-mobile-menu a{display:block;padding:13px 0;font-family:var(--FH);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.nav-mobile-menu a:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.nav-mobile-menu a:hover{color:var(--white)}
.nav-mobile-menu .nav-mobile-cta{margin-top:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));color:var(--white)!important;text-align:center;padding:14px 0;border-radius:var(--rp);border-bottom:none!important}
@media(max-width:768px){nav{padding:11px 18px}.nav-links{display:none}.nav-burger{display:flex}}

/* HERO */
.hero{position:relative;z-index:1;min-height:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:56px 24px 48px;overflow:hidden}
.orb1{position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:900px;height:750px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(123,45,255,.18) 0%,rgba(255,45,120,.07) 45%,transparent 68%);pointer-events:none;animation:ga 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.orb2{position:absolute;bottom:-20%;right:-5%;width:500px;height:500px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,238,255,.07) 0%,transparent 65%);pointer-events:none;animation:gb 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse}
@keyframes ga{from{opacity:.55}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes gb{from{opacity:.3;transform:scale(1)}to{opacity:.7;transform:scale(1.08)}}

.ep{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--purple);border:1px solid rgba(123,45,255,.4);background:rgba(123,45,255,.12);padding:6px 16px;border-radius:var(--rp);margin-bottom:18px;animation:up .8s ease both}
.ep .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple);animation:blink 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.12}}

.ht{font-family:var(--FH);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,6.4rem);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.035em;text-transform:uppercase;animation:up .9s .06s ease both}
.ht .l1{display:block;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.5));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.ht .l2{display:block;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple) 0%,var(--pink) 50%,var(--gold) 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 52px rgba(123,45,255,.55))}

.hd{font-family:var(--FS);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2.2vw,1.4rem);color:var(--muted);margin-top:22px;max-width:640px;animation:up 1s .12s ease both}
.hd strong{color:var(--white);font-style:normal;font-family:var(--FH);font-weight:600;font-size:.9em}

/* BUTTONS */
.acts{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:26px;animation:up 1s .25s ease both}
.bm{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:16px 36px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));color:var(--white);font-family:var(--FH);font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:var(--rp);border:none;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(123,45,255,.45),0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.bm::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.14),transparent 55%);pointer-events:none}
.bm:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(123,45,255,.7),0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.bwa{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:15px 26px;background:rgba(123,45,255,.12);color:rgba(199,153,255,.9);font-family:var(--FH);font-weight:600;font-size:.86rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:var(--rp);border:1px solid rgba(123,45,255,.35);transition:background .2s,transform .2s}
.bwa:hover{background:rgba(123,45,255,.22);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.bg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:15px 26px;background:transparent;color:var(--white);font-family:var(--FH);font-weight:600;font-size:.86rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:var(--rp);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);transition:border-color .2s,background .2s}
.bg:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.hm{margin-top:22px;font-size:.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.32);letter-spacing:.06em;animation:up 1s .32s ease both}
.hm strong{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.sc{position:absolute;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.22);animation:up 1s .65s ease both}
.sc .ar{width:18px;height:18px;border-right:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);transform:rotate(45deg);animation:bob .6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;margin-top:3px}
@keyframes bob{from{transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(0)}to{transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(4px)}}

/* PRESS STRIP */
.ps{position:relative;z-index:1;background:rgba(255,210,76,.055);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,210,76,.16);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,210,76,.16);padding:16px 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pi{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,210,76,.7)}
.pi .out{font-family:var(--FH);color:var(--gold)}
.pi .dt{color:rgba(255,210,76,.4);font-weight:400}
.psep{width:1px;height:18px;background:rgba(255,210,76,.18)}
.plbl{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,210,76,.3);margin-right:4px}

/* DIVIDER */
.div{position:relative;z-index:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(123,45,255,.4) 30%,rgba(255,45,120,.3) 70%,transparent);margin:0 28px}

/* STORY */
.story{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:88px 32px}
.sflag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:28px}
.sflag-bar{width:3px;height:30px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));border-radius:2px}
.sflag-txt{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--purple)}
.story h2{font-family:var(--FS);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(2rem,4.5vw,3.2rem);font-weight:400;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:32px}
.story h2 em{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--FH);font-weight:700;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.sb{font-size:1.06rem;line-height:1.85;color:rgba(255,255,255,.74)}
.sb p{margin-bottom:22px}
.sb p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.sb strong{color:var(--white);font-weight:600}
.sb em{font-family:var(--FS);font-style:italic;color:#c99fff;font-size:1.05em}
.sstats{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:40px;padding-top:36px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.sstat{flex:1;min-width:130px}
.ssn{font-family:var(--FH);font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.ssl{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px;line-height:1.4}

/* DAYS */
.days{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px 88px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.day{position:relative;border-radius:var(--r);border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);padding:40px 36px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.day:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 20px 56px rgba(123,45,255,.22)}
.day.sat::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-80px;right:-80px;width:280px;height:280px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(123,45,255,.26) 0%,transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
.day.sun::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-80px;right:-80px;width:280px;height:280px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,238,255,.16) 0%,transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
.dtag{display:inline-block;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:var(--rp);margin-bottom:18px}
.day.sat .dtag{background:rgba(123,45,255,.2);border:1px solid rgba(123,45,255,.5);color:#c99fff}
.day.sun .dtag{background:rgba(0,238,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(0,238,255,.4);color:var(--cyan)}
.dname{font-family:var(--FH);font-size:2rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:5px}
.ddl{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:4px}
.dtime{font-family:var(--FH);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:20px}
.dbody{font-size:.88rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);line-height:1.72;margin-bottom:22px}
.drows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.dr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:.82rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.ic{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.82rem;flex-shrink:0}
.day.sat .ic{background:rgba(123,45,255,.18)}
.day.sun .ic{background:rgba(0,238,255,.09)}
.dnote{margin-top:20px;padding:11px 15px;background:rgba(255,210,76,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,210,76,.2);border-radius:9px;font-size:.76rem;color:rgba(255,210,76,.8);line-height:1.5}

/* FINAL CTA */
.fcta{position:relative;z-index:1;text-align:center;padding:0 28px 100px}
.fctai{max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:24px;padding:56px 48px;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.fctai::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-80px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:400px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(123,45,255,.18),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
.fctai h2{font-family:var(--FH);font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.5rem);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:10px}
.fctai p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:28px;max-width:440px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.snote{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);background:rgba(255,210,76,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,210,76,.2);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:var(--rp);margin-bottom:24px}
.fctai-trio{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:8px}
.fctai-trio .btn-sec{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 28px;background:rgba(0,238,255,.08);color:rgba(0,238,255,.9);font-family:var(--FH);font-weight:700;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:var(--rp);border:1px solid rgba(0,238,255,.25);transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.fctai-trio .btn-sec:hover{background:rgba(0,238,255,.16);border-color:rgba(0,238,255,.5)}

/* FOOTER */
footer{position:relative;z-index:1;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding:40px 36px}
.ft{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;margin-bottom:28px}
.fb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--FH);font-weight:700;font-size:.88rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.fb img{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:4px;opacity:.8}

    <p>ZODIAC was founded in <strong>July 2020 by Jade Phoenix Hoskins — Lady Phoenix</strong>, a Trans woman who looked at Camden and decided the community deserved better. Not just a place to drink. A home with its name on the door.</p>
    <p>The permanent venue opened on <strong>5 November 2021</strong> at 119 Hampstead Road. What followed was five years of Trans Pride, drag cabarets, queer club nights, and the kind of Saturday evenings that people still talk about on Monday morning. Through a pandemic. Through financial pressure no independent venue should have to carry. Through every reason there could have been to close.</p>
    <p><em>ZODIAC stayed open. Open. Trading. Fighting.</em></p>
    <p>The community showed up. <strong>Over £300,000 raised for LGBTQ+ causes.</strong> Hundreds of events. Thousands of people who walked through those doors and called it theirs. On 9 May 2026, the doors opened again at noon. The community came home. This wasn't a launch. It was a return.</p>

}
.nav-links li a:hover{color:var(--text)}
.nav-links .nav-book a{
  background:var(--text);color:var(--bg);
  font-weight:700;padding:7px 16px;
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  transition:opacity .15s;
}
.nav-links .nav-book a:hover{opacity:.85}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .nav-links{display:none}
}

/* ─── TICKER ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ticker-rail{
  background:var(--surface);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  overflow:hidden;
  height:36px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;
}
.ticker-inner{
  display:flex;
  white-space:nowrap;
  animation:scroll-left 40s linear infinite;
  will-change:transform;
}
.ticker-inner:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
.ticker-item{
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  padding:0 24px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.ticker-item .t-hi{color:var(--text)}
.ticker-item .t-accent{color:var(--accent)}
.ticker-item .t-euv{color:var(--euv)}
.ticker-item .t-gold{color:var(--gold)}
@keyframes scroll-left{
  0%{transform:translateX(0)}
  100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}
}

/* ─── HERO ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.hero{
  padding-top:56px;
  min-height:100svh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;
  padding-bottom:72px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 50% -10%,rgba(192,96,255,.14) 0%,transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 30% at 85% 80%,rgba(0,158,227,.07) 0%,transparent 60%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
/* subtle grid */
.hero-bg::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:80px 80px;
}
.hero-inner{
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;
  width:100%;
}
.hero-status{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  margin-bottom:32px;
}
.hero-h1{
  font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,6.5rem);
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;
  line-height:.95;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:28px;
}
.hero-h1 em{font-style:italic;font-weight:900}
.hero-sub{
  font-size:clamp(.95rem,1.5vw,1.1rem);
  color:var(--sub);
  max-width:520px;
  line-height:1.65;
  margin-bottom:36px;
}
.hero-actions{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;
  padding:11px 22px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  transition:all .15s;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.btn-primary{background:var(--text);color:var(--bg)}
.btn-primary:hover{opacity:.88}
.btn-ghost{
  color:var(--sub);
  border:1px solid var(--border-md);
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
}
.btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}

/* countdown strip */
.hero-countdown{
  margin-top:56px;
  padding-top:32px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.cd-label{
  font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  margin-right:32px;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.cd-units{display:flex;gap:0}
.cd-unit{
  text-align:center;padding:0 24px;
  border-right:1px solid var(--border);
}
.cd-unit:first-child{padding-left:0}
.cd-unit:last-child{border-right:none}
.cd-n{
  font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.8rem);font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;
  color:var(--text);
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.cd-t{
  font-size:.6rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);margin-top:3px;
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .cd-label{width:100%;margin-bottom:16px;margin-right:0}
  .cd-unit{padding:0 16px}
}

/* ─── SECTION WRAPPER ────────────────────────────────── */
.wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

/* ─── FEATURED STRIP ─────────────────────────────────── */
.featured{
  padding:80px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.feat-header{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;
  flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;
  margin-bottom:40px;
}
.feat-h2{
  font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2rem);
  font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.1;
}
.feat-h2 em{font-style:italic;font-weight:800}

/* two col grid */
.feat-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:1px;
  background:var(--border);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  overflow:hidden;
}
@media(max-width:720px){.feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.feat-card{
  background:var(--bg);
  padding:36px 32px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
  min-height:340px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:background .2s;
}
.feat-card:hover{background:var(--surface)}
.feat-card-glow{
  position:absolute;
  top:-40%;left:-20%;
  width:60%;height:60%;
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.15;
  filter:blur(60px);
}
.fc-reopen .feat-card-glow{background:var(--accent)}
.fc-euv    .feat-card-glow{background:var(--euv)}
.feat-tag{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:4px 11px;border-radius:100px;
  align-self:flex-start;margin-bottom:24px;
}
.tag-reopen{
  background:rgba(192,96,255,.1);
  border:1px solid rgba(192,96,255,.25);
  color:var(--accent);
}
.tag-euv{
  background:rgba(0,158,227,.1);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,158,227,.25);
  color:var(--euv);
}
.feat-date{
  font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.feat-title{
  font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.5vw,1.8rem);
  font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.1;
  margin-bottom:12px;
}
.feat-title em{font-style:italic;font-weight:800}
.feat-body{
  font-size:.875rem;color:var(--sub);
  line-height:1.6;max-width:360px;
  margin-bottom:24px;
}
.feat-meta{
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  margin-bottom:20px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.cap-live{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  color:var(--warn);font-weight:700;
}
.cap-live::before{
  content:'';width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--warn);
  animation:blink 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  flex-shrink:0;
}

/* inline btn */
.btn-invert{
  background:transparent;
  border:1px solid var(--border-md);
  color:var(--sub);
}
.btn-invert:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);color:var(--text)}

/* ─── FILTER BAR ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.filter-bar{
  position:sticky;top:56px;z-index:100;
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.96);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.filter-inner{
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;
  padding:0 24px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;
  overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;
  height:48px;
}
.filter-inner::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.f-btn{
  flex-shrink:0;
  padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.07em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--sub);
  border:1px solid transparent;
  transition:all .15s;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.f-btn:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border-md)}
.f-btn.is-active{
  color:var(--text);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border-color:var(--border-md);
}
/* type-specific active */
.f-btn[data-f="drag"].is-active    {color:#f472b6;border-color:rgba(244,114,182,.3);background:rgba(244,114,182,.08)}
.f-btn[data-f="karaoke"].is-active {color:#38bdf8;border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.3);background:rgba(56,189,248,.08)}
.f-btn[data-f="dj"].is-active      {color:var(--accent);border-color:rgba(192,96,255,.3);background:var(--accent-lo)}
.f-btn[data-f="pride"].is-active   {color:#4ade80;border-color:rgba(74,222,128,.3);background:rgba(74,222,128,.08)}
.f-btn[data-f="special"].is-active {color:var(--gold);border-color:rgba(240,192,64,.3);background:rgba(240,192,64,.08)}
.f-btn[data-f="eurovision"].is-active{color:var(--euv);border-color:rgba(0,158,227,.3);background:rgba(0,158,227,.08)}
.f-btn[data-f="recurring"].is-active{color:var(--sub);border-color:var(--border-md)}

/* ─── EVENTS ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.events{padding:64px 0 80px}
.month-block{margin-bottom:56px}
.month-block.is-hidden{display:none}
.month-label{
  font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);
  padding-bottom:14px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom:0;
}

/* event row */
.ev{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:64px 1fr auto;
  gap:20px;align-items:center;
  padding:18px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  position:relative;
  transition:background .12s;
}
.ev:hover{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
  margin:0 -16px;padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px;
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  border-bottom-color:transparent;
}
.ev.is-hidden{display:none}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .ev{grid-template-columns:52px 1fr}
  .ev-action{display:none}
}

/* featured glow bar */
.ev.ev-feat::before{
  content:'';
  position:absolute;left:0;top:12px;bottom:12px;
  width:2px;border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--accent);
  opacity:.6;
}
.ev.ev-feat:hover::before{opacity:1}

.ev-date{
  text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;
}
.ev-day{
  font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;
  color:var(--text);
}
.ev-wday{
  font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);
  margin-top:2px;
}

.ev-body{min-width:0}
.ev-tags{
  display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}
.ev-tag{
  font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:2px 8px;border-radius:100px;
}
.ev-tag-drag     {color:#f472b6;background:rgba(244,114,182,.1)}
.ev-tag-karaoke  {color:#38bdf8;background:rgba(56,189,248,.1)}
.ev-tag-dj       {color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-lo)}
.ev-tag-pride    {color:#4ade80;background:rgba(74,222,128,.1)}
.ev-tag-special  {color:var(--gold);background:rgba(240,192,64,.1)}
.ev-tag-eurovision{color:var(--euv);background:rgba(0,158,227,.1)}
.ev-tag-recurring{color:var(--dim);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.ev-tag-feat     {color:var(--accent);font-style:italic}

.ev-name{
  font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.01em;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
  margin-bottom:3px;
}
.ev-meta{
  font-size:.75rem;color:var(--sub);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.ev-cap{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  color:var(--warn);font-weight:600;
  font-size:.72rem;
}
.ev-cap::before{
  content:'';width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--warn);
  animation:blink 1.4s infinite;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.ev-free{
  color:#4ade80;font-weight:700;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
}

.ev-action{flex-shrink:0}
.ev-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:7px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  border:1px solid var(--border-md);
  color:var(--sub);
  white-space:nowrap;
  transition:all .15s;
}
.ev-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:var(--text)}
.ev-btn-free{border-color:rgba(74,222,128,.25);color:#4ade80}
.ev-btn-free:hover{background:rgba(74,222,128,.1);border-color:rgba(74,222,128,.5)}
.ev-btn-hot{border-color:rgba(192,96,255,.3);color:var(--accent)}
.ev-btn-hot:hover{background:var(--accent-lo)}
.ev-btn-euv{border-color:rgba(0,158,227,.3);color:var(--euv)}
.ev-btn-euv:hover{background:rgba(0,158,227,.1)}

/* recurring rows */
.ev-recurring .ev-day{font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--dim)}

/* ─── SCHEDULE ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.schedule{
  padding:72px 0;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--surface);
}
.sch-grid{
  margin-top:36px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);
  gap:1px;
  background:var(--border);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  overflow:hidden;
}
@media(max-width:960px){.sch-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.sch-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.sch-day{background:var(--bg);padding:18px 14px}
.sch-dname{
  font-size:.62rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);
  margin-bottom:14px;
}
.sch-ev{
  margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:10px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.sch-ev:last-child{border-bottom:none;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
.sch-en{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:2px}
.sch-et{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--sub)}
.sch-er{font-size:.62rem;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;margin-top:1px}

/* ─── NEWSLETTER ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.nl{
  padding:72px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.nl-wrap{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:end;
}
@media(max-width:720px){.nl-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}}
.nl-h{
  font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.2rem);
  font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.1;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.nl-h em{font-style:italic;font-weight:800}
.nl-sub{font-size:.875rem;color:var(--sub);line-height:1.6;max-width:380px}
.nl-form{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nl-input{

  border-radius:var(--r-sm);

  color:var(--text);font-family:var(--fam);font-size:.875rem;

}
.nl-input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}
.nl-input:focus{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.nl-note{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--dim);margin-top:8px}
.nl-note a{color:var(--sub);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}

/* ─── PROMOTER ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.promo{padding:56px 0}
.promo-inner{
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);

}
@media(max-width:640px){.promo-inner{padding:24px 20px}}
.promo-h{
  font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:800;

}
.promo-h em{font-style:italic;font-weight:800}
.promo-sub{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--sub)}

.footer{

}
.footer-grid{

}

@media(max-width:480px){.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.footer-brand-name{
  font-size:1rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}
.footer-brand-sub{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--sub);line-height:1.6;max-width:240px;margin-bottom:16px}
.footer-ht{
  font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);

}
.footer-list{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.footer-list a{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--sub);transition:color .15s}
.footer-list a:hover{color:var(--text)}
.footer-bottom{
  padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);

  font-size:.72rem;color:var(--dim);
}
.footer-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:4px 11px;border-radius:100px;

}

.pride-bar{

}

.pride-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  font-size:.65rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;

  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,0,24,.15),rgba(134,0,125,.15));

.ev-tag-pride-season{

}
/* ─── MISC ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media(max-width:480px){
  .btn{font-size:.75rem;padding:10px 16px}
}

<script>
// ── COUNTDOWN ─────────────────────────────────────────
function tick(){
  const target=new Date('2026-05-09T12:00:00');
  const diff=target-new Date();
  if(diff<=0){['d','h','m','s'].forEach(k=>document.getElementById('cd-'+k).textContent='00');return}
  const d=Math.floor(diff/864e5);
  const h=Math.floor(diff%864e5/36e5);
  const m=Math.floor(diff%36e5/6e4);
  const s=Math.floor(diff%6e4/1e3);
  document.getElementById('cd-d').textContent=String(d).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-h').textContent=String(h).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-m').textContent=String(m).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-s').textContent=String(s).padStart(2,'0');
}
tick();setInterval(tick,1000);

// ── FILTER ────────────────────────────────────────────
document.querySelectorAll('.f-btn').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.f-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('is-active'));
    btn.classList.add('is-active');
    const f=btn.dataset.f;
    document.querySelectorAll('.ev').forEach(ev=>{
      ev.classList.toggle('is-hidden', f!=='all' && ev.dataset.type!==f);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.month-block').forEach(mb=>{
      const visible=[...mb.querySelectorAll('.ev')].some(e=>!e.classList.contains('is-hidden'));
      mb.classList.toggle('is-hidden',!visible);
    });
  });
});
</script>
